Name: Rented Tools
Author: JarvieK
Description:
[size=3]The Harvest Moon style of tool upgrading mechanics is somehow frustrating, especially when you realized tomorrow is a sunny day right after leaving the watering can to Clint![/size]

[size=3]This mod allows you to rent the basic tool while yours is being upgraded.
[/size]

[size=5]Installation[/size]

[size=3]install [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url][/size]

[size=3]unpack the zip file, move to the game directory[/size]

[size=3]launch game with SMAPI
[/size]

[size=3]Feel free to report bugs, feature requests, etc. to here:

https://github.com/Jarvie8176/StardewMods/issues/new

[/size]
